text:
nora_cs: Heads-up — Radiant (enterprise tier) asked for a temporary regional QPS bump for EU + APAC next week. They have an onboarding demo + heavy test traffic. Also need an IP allowlist for 34.82.120.0/24 and 52.14.200.5. Renewal flagged this week, CSM wants reassurance we can handle demo. Can we provision a 2x-4x qps window Mon–Wed 09:00–18:00 UTC? cc @sam_ops @lee_prod
sam_ops: Quick q — is this for hosted API or Dedicated?
nora_cs: Hosted for now (API keys). They may move to Dedicated later if traffic steady.
lee_prod: We can do a temporary token policy and add the IPs to the global allowlist. Need account ID + expected peak qps. Also prefer exact window timestamps to schedule autorevoke.
nora_cs: Account ID R-78342. Expected peak ~120 qps (spikes), baseline ~25. Requesting bump to 100 qps for the window to be safe. Window: 2026-04-06T09:00:00Z -> 2026-04-08T18:00:00Z.
jordan_cs: I'll open the internal ticket now and loop finance for the usage spike note. Also scheduling the renewal call on Thu — CSM wants this guaranteed.
sam_ops: Noted. We should canary the routing so we don't blow up EU pool. Proposal: 25% traffic to eu-dedicated variant (if capacity), rest on hosted with raised qps. Fallback to throttle if error rate > 5%.
lee_prod: Drafted the policy below — will create in staging for validation. Auto-rollback set.
```
# temporary rate policy (example)
resource: token:R-78342
rate_limit: 100 # reqs/sec
window_start: 2026-04-06T09:00:00Z
window_end: 2026-04-08T18:00:00Z
allowlist_ips:
  - 34.82.120.0/24
  - 52.14.200.5
canary: 25% -> eu-dedicated, fallback: throttle@90%
autorevoke: true
notify_on_error: [#customer-success, @eng-oncall]
```
nora_cs: Perfect — include billing estimate in the ticket and call it out in the renewal slide. Also tell Radiant the bump will be autorevoked at window end.
jordan_cs: Ticket created: CS-11258. Added billing estimate (~+18% for window) and assigned to finance for approval if over threshold. Pinged @lee_prod for push schedule.
deploy-bot: policy CS-11258 preview created in staging (id: preview-78342).
lee_prod: I'll push the policy to prod Mon 07:30 UTC for a final smoke test, then enable at 09:00 UTC. I'll tag eng-oncall and set a 30m rollback window.
nora_cs: Awesome — CSM will run the demo Tue 12:00 UTC and will use test key. I'll post test key + request replay steps here once staging preview is green. :rocket: 
jordan_cs: I'll follow up after renewal call with notes. If anything changes, update CS-11258.
sam_ops: Sounds good. I'll monitor queue depth and error rates during the window and update the thread if we see any anomalies.
